scripts.text:
delete from edw.Fact_Backlog_Snapshot where ProcessDate = cast(GETDATE() as date);

insert into edw.Fact_Backlog_Snapshot
SELECT SourceSystemID
      ,Site
      ,BilltoCountryCode
      ,BilltoCountry
      ,BilltoState
      ,BilltoZipCode
      ,ShiptoCountryCode
      ,ShiptoCountry
      ,ShiptoState
      ,ShiptoZipCode
      ,OrderNumber
      ,OrderLine
      ,TransDate
      ,OrderDate
      ,Freight
      ,Tax
      ,CustomerID
      ,ItemID
      ,Price
      ,Discount
      ,Quantity
      ,Amount
      ,Currency
      ,IntRepName
      ,ExtRepName
      ,PlannedDeliveryDate
      ,CustomerRequestDate
      ,DeliveryDate
      ,ApplicationID
      ,RecordDate
      ,OrderLineStatus
      ,OrderType
      ,Complete
	  ,cast(GETDATE() as date) ProcessDate
  FROM edw.Fact_Backlog
  ;
